headline: Interaction with a keyboard behind it

items.title: DECODE
items.detail: ScrambleText on enter, once. It runs on the title, restores the real text on unmount, and never fires under reduced motion.

items.title: MAGNETIC
items.detail: quickTo per axis, created once. Fine pointers only — chasing a finger that leaves the screen just makes the grid twitch.

items.title: FLIP
items.detail: It is a button, so Enter and Space work for free. aria-expanded announces the state; the hidden face is aria-hidden so it is not read twice.
